findings.title: Pass the user to isConditionalPasskeysEnabled
findings.body: This calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() without arguments, but the method added to UsernamePasswordForm requires a UserModel argument and there is no zero-argument overload in the class hierarchy shown here. The services module will not compile, preventing the application and the new tests from building.

findings.title: Keep conditional passkeys enabled when no user is selected
findings.body: The new helper requires user != null, but on a normal initial login context.getUser() is null. Both authenticate() and the error challenge now use this helper, so they no longer call fillContextForm() for ordinary username-less login. Consequently the login page loses its passkey form, challenge, and conditional UI, preventing discoverable-passkey login through these forms until a user has already been selected. Enable passkeys for an unidentified user as well as for re-authentication; the existing initial-login passkey tests exercise this regression.
